source: បច្ចេកទេស ដាំដុះដំណាំដំឡូងជ្វា (Sweet Potato Cultivation Techniques), MAFF General Directorate of Agriculture, 2018
text: Watering should be adapted to the crop's growth stage. The source indicates a lighter watering requirement (in the range of roughly 18-20mm per week, applied once weekly) during vine growth, increasing to a heavier requirement (roughly 40-45mm per week) during the tuber bulking stage. Where rainfall and soil moisture are already sufficient, additional irrigation is not needed.
caveat: The specific millimeter figures for weekly water requirement come from a source passage with some legibility limitations; treat as approximate rather than precise irrigation-scheduling data. See also the duplicate-check caveat on Source C's overview file.
